query:
SELECT s.id, s.saleDate, s.finalAmount, s.channel
FROM sales s
JOIN customers c ON s.customerId = c.id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Vitor Hugo%' AND s.channel = 'A_PRAZO'
ORDER BY s.saleDate DESC;
